shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in an emerald sweater at the pinboard-side window seat details the experience, alongside a man in a navy blazer at the entrance-side window seat, a woman in a burgundy cardigan at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a mustard polo at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in a navy blazer asks a clarifying question, and the woman in an emerald sweater answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a burgundy cardigan asks a follow-up question, and the woman in an emerald sweater replies to her and the man in a navy blazer.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
